Production deployment policy.

Canonical application source: this repository's main branch only.
Production domain: hisabsarraf.new.tg
Build command: npm run build
Deployment workflow: .github/workflows/deploy-production.yml

Only pushes to main trigger production deployment. Manual deployment is also restricted to main and requires explicit confirmation.
No other branch or repository is used as a production source.

Preserve the existing CNAME and all production user, authentication, and financial data.
This policy changes GitHub Pages deployment only; it does not authorize database migrations or data changes.
